top_signals.title: Wall Street Braces for Biggest Treasury Sales Overhaul in Years
top_signals.summary: After Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent surprised dealers with his willingness to intervene in the bond market to drive down yields in recent months, Wall Street is now girding for the biggest revamp in guidance for US Treasuries issuance since early 2024.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: After Tech Rout, Investors Gird for More Wild Days for Stocks
top_signals.summary: The stock market got a long-awaited jolt of volatility late last week after disappointing earnings from technology giants added to angst around the AI-driven rally.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
